bio: I am so happy to meet you and serve as your proctor for your first year at Harvard. Carter, the Straus Puppy is also super excited. I am a native of Jacksonville, Florida, a Chicagoan and an alumni of Boston College and Northwestern University and most recently, a new doctor from Harvard Graduate School of Education. I will be teaching next year at HGSE and Harvard Kennedy School, but my favorite job is helping you navigate the incredible opportunity before you in a way that is kind and authentic to who you are.
